title: M Sport trim and sport mode impressions
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly discuss satisfaction with the BMW 120 M Sport trim and driving character, with some complaints about sportiness cues and interior quality, while many fragments only mention sport-related trims or modes without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the 120 M Sport as enjoyable, rewarding to drive, and satisfying overall.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize weaker upholstery quality, a lack of sport-hatch character, and missing M Sport styling details.

mixed.summary: The mixed review says the owner is pleased overall with the BMW 120 M Sport, but the sample does not include the offsetting drawback in the provided fragment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly reference previous Sport or M Sport models, switching drive modes, or missing features without enough context to assign clear sentiment.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are too short or context-dependent to determine sentiment confidently.
This cluster mixes references to M Sport trim names, sport mode usage, comparisons with older Sport models, and equipment mentions rather than a single tightly defined issue.
Several negative-assigned examples are only weakly explicit in the fragment text, so the available evidence for specific complaints is limited.
